item.title: How OmniPaxos handles partial connectivity - and why other protocols can’t
item.description: State machine replication (SMR) protocols such as Raft, VR, and MultiPaxos are widely used to build replicated services in the cloud. These protocols depend on a stable leader to make progress. However, as shown by the 6+ hour Cloudflare outage in 2020, partial connectivity can cause the leader election in these protocols to fail. In a previous post by Howard and Abraham, they showed how Raft overcomes some partial connectivity scenarios by incorporating new logic into the leader election process.
